Bhai, yeh Python script aapke kaam aayega. Isme pandas ka use kiya gaya hai, toh pehle check kare ki aapke system me install hai ya nahi. Agar nahi toh `pip install pandas` command se install kare. 

Yeh script CSV file ko read karega, null values ko hatayega, duplicates bhi remove karega aur ek naye CSV file me save karega. 

```python
# Pandas import karo
import pandas as pd

# CSV file read karo
df = pd.read_csv('input.csv')  # 'input.csv' aapke file ka naam hoga

# Null values hatayega (rows jo kisi bhi column me null hai woh hat jayenge)
df = df.dropna()

# Duplicates hatayega (sabhi columns ka base par)
df = df.drop_duplicates()

# Cleaned data ko naye CSV file me save karo
df.to_csv('cleaned_data.csv', index=False)  # 'cleaned_data.csv' naye file ka naam hoga
```
